v2-d1-t-1.title: Understanding Spark Execution in Databricks
v2-d1-t-1.note: Driver coordinates, executors process partitions in parallel. SparkSession is not covered.

v2-d1-t-1.title: Introduction to Databricks Compute
v2-d1-t-1.note: A cluster is one driver node plus worker nodes.

v2-d1-t-2.title: Understanding Shuffle Operations, Data Skew, and Disk Spilling
v2-d1-t-2.note: Which operations force a shuffle: joins, aggregations, group by, sort, distinct (the wide ones). Lazy evaluation is not covered.

v2-d1-t-3.title: Understanding Spark Execution in Databricks
v2-d1-t-3.note: A job is split into stages, a stage into tasks, one task per partition.

v2-d1-t-3.title: Checkpointing
v2-d1-t-3.note: How Structured Streaming recovers from a failure (offset and commit logs). Not the same as lineage-based recovery.

v2-d2-t-3.title: Introduction to PySpark
v2-d2-t-3.note: A DataFrame is a distributed table with rows and named columns. RDDs are not covered.

v2-d3-t-1.title: Understanding Shuffle Operations, Data Skew, and Disk Spilling
v2-d3-t-1.note: Names AQE as a runtime optimizer, for skew only. The shuffle partitions setting is not covered.

v2-d4-t-1.title: Introduction to Delta Lake
v2-d4-t-1.note: Delta stores its data as Parquet, a columnar binary format. ORC is not covered.

v2-d4-t-1.title: Extract Addresses Data using read_files Function - TSV
v2-d4-t-1.note: Self-describing formats (JSON, Parquet) vs CSV and text, which need read_files options or an external table.

v2-d4-t-2.title: Understanding Data Scanning and Small File Problems
v2-d4-t-2.note: Filter early, select only the columns you need, partition pruning, and Delta data skipping.

v2-d4-t-2.title: Insert Overwrite & Partitioning
v2-d4-t-2.note: A table partitioned by date, and INSERT OVERWRITE on a single partition.

v2-d4-t-3.title: Understanding Data Scanning and Small File Problems
v2-d4-t-3.note: The small file problem: task and metadata overhead, fixed by compaction. Splittable formats are not covered.

v2-d4-t-3.title: Compaction - OPTIMIZE and ZORDER
v2-d4-t-3.note: Several writes make several small files; OPTIMIZE compacts them (check with DESCRIBE DETAIL).

v2-d4-t-4.title: Auto Loader - Schema Evolution
v2-d4-t-4.note: New columns arriving in the source are added to the table automatically.

v2-d4-t-4.title: Introduction to Delta Lake
v2-d4-t-4.note: What Delta adds on top of plain Parquet: a transaction log and ACID transactions. Avro is not covered.

v2-d5-t-1.title: Understanding Shuffle Operations, Data Skew, and Disk Spilling
v2-d5-t-1.note: What a shuffle is, why it costs network, disk, memory and time, and the shuffle read/write signs in the Spark UI.

v2-d5-t-2.title: Understanding Shuffle Operations, Data Skew, and Disk Spilling
v2-d5-t-2.note: Broadcast join: copy the small table to every executor and skip the big shuffle. Shuffle hash join is not covered.

v2-d5-t-4.title: Understanding Shuffle Operations, Data Skew, and Disk Spilling
v2-d5-t-4.note: Cutting shuffles with broadcast joins and early filters. Bucketing is not covered.

v2-d6-t-1.title: Understanding Shuffle Operations, Data Skew, and Disk Spilling
v2-d6-t-1.note: What skew is, a few slow tasks in the Spark UI, and why the slowest task holds up the whole stage.

v2-d6-t-2.title: Understanding Shuffle Operations, Data Skew, and Disk Spilling
v2-d6-t-2.note: Fixes it mentions: repartition, avoid skewed keys, filter early. Salting is not covered.

v2-d6-t-3.title: Understanding Shuffle Operations, Data Skew, and Disk Spilling
v2-d6-t-3.note: AQE can adjust partitioning at runtime to ease skew.

v2-d6-t-4.title: Understanding Shuffle Operations, Data Skew, and Disk Spilling
v2-d6-t-4.note: Repartitioning spreads data more evenly. coalesce is not covered.

v2-d7-t-2.title: Understanding Shuffle Operations, Data Skew, and Disk Spilling
v2-d7-t-2.note: What spilling is, when it happens (big shuffles, joins, sorts), and the spill metrics in the Spark UI. GC and executor cores are not covered.

v2-d8-t-1.title: Spark User Defined Functions (UDFs)
v2-d8-t-1.note: Creating UDFs. Databricks recommends SQL UDFs over Python UDFs because Spark optimizes them better.

v2-d8-t-1.title: Higher Order Functions (Array)
v2-d8-t-1.note: Built-in transform, filter, exists and aggregate work on arrays directly, no UDF needed.

v2-d8-t-1.title: Higher Order Functions (Map)
v2-d8-t-1.note: The same built-in approach for map columns.

v2-d8-t-3.title: Data Discovery, Audit & Lineage Demo
v2-d8-t-3.note: Unity Catalog lineage: upstream and downstream tables, column-level lineage.

v2-d8-t-4.title: Structured Streaming - Introduction
v2-d8-t-4.note: Streaming basics: micro-batches and the unbounded table. Watermarks are not covered.

v2-d8-t-4.title: Trigger & OutputMode
v2-d8-t-4.note: Update mode suits aggregations with watermarks, but the course does not teach watermarks.

v2-d9-t-1.title: Introduction to Delta Lake
v2-d9-t-1.note: Delta Lake is Parquet plus a transaction log: ACID for batch and streaming.

v2-d9-t-1.title: Delta Transaction Log
v2-d9-t-1.note: Open the _delta_log folder: one JSON commit per operation.

v2-d9-t-1.title: Support for ACID Transactions
v2-d9-t-1.note: Readers get a consistent view while writers are still working.

v2-d9-t-1.title: Delta Lake Version History
v2-d9-t-1.note: Table history, time travel and RESTORE: every version is a snapshot.

v2-d9-t-2.title: COPY INTO and MERGE Command
v2-d9-t-2.note: MERGE does insert, update and delete in one statement. Plain UPDATE and DELETE are not shown on their own.

v2-d9-t-2.title: Delta Lake Table & Column Properties
v2-d9-t-2.note: NOT NULL constraints and generated columns. Schema enforcement itself is not covered.

v2-d9-t-3.title: Understanding Delta Lake Optimization Concepts
v2-d9-t-3.note: Why Delta tables need upkeep, and the toolbox: OPTIMIZE, Z-order, VACUUM.

v2-d9-t-3.title: Remove Unused Files - VACUUM
v2-d9-t-3.note: VACUUM removes unreferenced files older than the 7-day retention.

v2-d9-t-3.title: Liquid Clustering
v2-d9-t-3.note: The newer replacement for partitioning and Z-order (beyond the checklist).

v2-d9-t-3.title: Understanding Predictive Optimization
v2-d9-t-3.note: Runs OPTIMIZE and VACUUM for you in the background (beyond the checklist).

v2-d9-t-4.title: Delta Lake Version History
v2-d9-t-4.note: Table history and versions. Change Data Feed itself is not covered.
